persona.name: dumper
persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Add Spanish subtitles to this English clip, please. Leave her voice in English and keep the whole video as it is.
bank.Target language and regional preference: Spanish; neutral, broadly understandable Spanish is fine.
bank.Translation wording: Your call; faithfully translate her greeting and offer to show three easy ways to make mornings less stressful.
bank.Subtitle delivery and style: Put readable Spanish subtitles on the video. Styling is your call.
bank.Size and framing: Preserve the source framing; free-tier 480p is fine.
bank.Audio: Keep her English voice unchanged. Do not dub or add music.

messages.text: Could you add Spanish subtitles to this English clip I've attached, please? I want to share it with people I know who are more comfortable reading Spanish. Her voice should stay in English, so please leave her voice unchanged. I get a little nervous that asking for subtitles will somehow turn into a bigger edit than I meant. Apart from adding the subtitles, please keep the whole video exactly as it is.
